source_theorems.name: QFORM-NEAR-ZERO-HALF-RIESZ-ONLY-FALSE-v1
source_theorems.scope_used: prevents declaring the star alternative paid by a merely near-zero pivot plus one cross row

new_mathematics.intersection_identity: For Z=[[z,a^T],[b,C]] at the partner heavy row/column, the complete incident 2x2 minor bank equals ||zC-ba^T||_F^2 exactly.
new_mathematics.schur_branch: If |z|>=1/10 then |z| ||C-ba^T/z||_F > sqrt(2349/5000), hence the regularized Schur residual has Frobenius norm >0.6854195795.
new_mathematics.star_branch: If |z|<1/10 then ||a||^2,||b||^2>49/50, ||C||_F^2<1/25, Z is within Frobenius distance <1/sqrt(20) of [[0,a^T],[b,0]], sigma_2(Z)>0.7663426959, and the full incident determinant bank sharpens to >576/625.
new_mathematics.partner_application: For A_m=diag(1,[[0,H_m],[H_m,0]]) with H_m=U_m diag(1+nu/(2m)) U_m^T and normalized Sylvester-Hadamard U_m, any selected three positive eigenvectors have max coordinate leverage 3/(2m)->0. Partner r19 has theta>=m*256/257>=1024/257>2.01 at gamma=1, so ||p||inf<1543 for all independent cap-one inputs, uniformly in m.
